Dear Sir/ Madam, 
 
Sub: Intimation of Earnings Call – H1 FY27 
 
This is to inform that HDFC Life Insurance Company Limited (“the Company”) will host earnings 
conference call with analysts and investors on Thursday, October 15, 2026 at 16:15 hours (IST), to 
discuss the financial performance of the Company for H1 FY27. The details of the earnings call are 
enclosed herewith. 
 
An audio recording of the earnings call will be made available on the Company’s website at 
http://www.hdfclife.com in due course.
